description: Deployable Direct Lake semantic model over HotelGuestServices aggregate tables plus limited HotelOperations shortcuts.
limitations: Food and beverage revenue is not present in the committed CSV contract; the model returns BLANK() for Food and Beverage Revenue and TRevPAR.
GOPPAR, NRevPAR, CPOR, Booking Pace, and Pickup beyond the committed columns remain out of scope for Phase 1 and are not emitted as report measures.
